system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"I still wish the <USER> iPad app was more like the desktop version and not the phone version. It just looks and feels really bad to use. Not how you make a tablet app at all."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Good to know, thanks! We're launching in countries as often as possible, so you'll be notified via email if it happens"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address the customer's feedback about the iPad app experience."}
